rektion: sich (Dat.) / jdm. etw. (Akk.) erfüllen (einen Traum, einen Wunsch); eine Aufgabe / Bedingung erfüllen
meaning_en: to fulfil (a dream, a wish); to meet (a requirement)
definition_de: einen Wunsch oder Traum wahr werden lassen; auch: tun, was verlangt wird (eine Pflicht / die Voraussetzungen erfüllen)
example_de: Mit 75 Jahren hat sich mein Opa endlich seinen Traum erfüllt: eine Fahrt im Heißluftballon.
example_en: At 75, my grandpa finally fulfilled his dream: a hot-air balloon ride.
visual_idea: Collocation 'sich einen Traum erfüllen': an old man beaming with raised arms in a balloon basket high above the land. Pure joy plus an obvious 'once in a lifetime' activity makes 'dream come true' readable, and the age in the sentence explains 'endlich'. Rejected: 'die Voraussetzungen erfüllen' (a job interview shows nothing) and 'jdm. einen Wunsch erfüllen' (a gift reads as 'schenken').
image_prompt: an old man with white hair and a white beard stands in the wicker basket of a colourful hot-air balloon high in the sky, both arms raised in joy, laughing with tears of happiness, the striped balloon envelope above him; far below rolling green hills, small villages and a river in soft sunrise light, a few other balloons in the distance
negative_prompt: text, letters, watermark, signature, caption, blurry, extra fingers, deformed hands, cluttered background, multiple panels
video_prompt: an old man with white hair stands in the basket of a hot-air balloon floating slowly over green hills at sunrise; he looks down in wonder, then raises both arms and laughs with joy; slow camera drifting alongside the basket
